units.locator: INSTRUCTIONS ON THE PROCEDURE FOR GRANTING AWARDS AND CONFERRING HONORARY TITLES OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW
units.text: 1. General provisions
units.label: Point 1

units.locator: INSTRUCTIONS ON THE PROCEDURE FOR GRANTING AWARDS AND CONFERRING HONORARY TITLES OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW
units.text: 1. These Instructions establish the procedure for initiating and considering petitions for the distinctions ‘For Services to Moscow’ and ‘For Impeccable Service to the City of Moscow’, the honorary badges ‘Honoured Teacher of the City of Moscow’, ‘Honoured Physician of the City of Moscow’ and ‘Honoured Industrialist of the City of Moscow’, the award of Prizes of the City of Moscow and the declaration of the Commendation of the Mayor of Moscow (hereinafter, awards), and for conferring professional honorary titles of the City of Moscow (hereinafter, honorary titles) <*>, preparing award documentation, presenting awards and breast badges for honorary titles, and issuing recipients with duplicates of lost awards, breast badges for honorary titles and the associated documents.
units.label: Point 1

units.locator: INSTRUCTIONS ON THE PROCEDURE FOR GRANTING AWARDS AND CONFERRING HONORARY TITLES OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW
units.text: 2. Executive authorities and local self-government bodies, institutions and organisations of the City of Moscow organise the granting of awards and conferral of honorary titles on citizens in accordance with Law of the City of Moscow of 05.09.2001 No. 38 ‘On Awards and Honorary Titles of the City of Moscow’, this Decree and other normative legal acts concerning awards and honorary titles.
units.label: Point 2

units.locator: INSTRUCTIONS ON THE PROCEDURE FOR GRANTING AWARDS AND CONFERRING HONORARY TITLES OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW
units.text: 3. Citizens (workforces, organisations) are nominated for awards and honorary titles for services to Moscow and a significant contribution to the socioeconomic, scientific, technological and cultural development of the city, and for specific outstanding achievements in professional and charitable activities.
units.label: Point 3

units.locator: INSTRUCTIONS ON THE PROCEDURE FOR GRANTING AWARDS AND CONFERRING HONORARY TITLES OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW
units.text: 4. Simultaneous nomination of citizens (workforces, organisations) for awards and honorary titles is not permitted.
units.label: Point 4

units.locator: INSTRUCTIONS ON THE PROCEDURE FOR GRANTING AWARDS AND CONFERRING HONORARY TITLES OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW
units.text: 5. A further award for new merits may be granted no earlier than five years after the previous award or conferral of an honorary title (including receipt of a state award of the Russian Federation), except for nominations for courage and selfless actions shown in the performance of official or civic duty.
units.label: Point 5

units.locator: INSTRUCTIONS ON THE PROCEDURE FOR GRANTING AWARDS AND CONFERRING HONORARY TITLES OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW
units.text: By decision of the Mayor of Moscow, a further award may be granted before the expiry of the 5-year period.
units.label: Point 5 · “By decision of the Mayor of Moscow, a further award may be…”

units.locator: INSTRUCTIONS ON THE PROCEDURE FOR GRANTING AWARDS AND CONFERRING HONORARY TITLES OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW
units.text: 6. Repeat nomination for awards of the same name is not permitted unless otherwise provided by the regulations governing those awards.
units.label: Point 6

units.locator: INSTRUCTIONS ON THE PROCEDURE FOR GRANTING AWARDS AND CONFERRING HONORARY TITLES OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW
units.text: 7. Nominations of citizens (workforces, organisations) for awards and honorary titles must not be made on a mass basis. They are strictly selective and are made only where other incentives have been exhausted or where such incentives would not correspond to the significance of the merits and achievements.
units.label: Point 7

units.locator: INSTRUCTIONS ON THE PROCEDURE FOR GRANTING AWARDS AND CONFERRING HONORARY TITLES OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW
units.text: In exceptional cases, for particularly outstanding services to Moscow, the Mayor of Moscow decides to grant an award or confer an honorary title without applying the requirements established by the regulations governing those awards or honorary titles.
units.label: Point 7 · “In exceptional cases, for particularly outstanding services to…”

units.locator: INSTRUCTIONS ON THE PROCEDURE FOR GRANTING AWARDS AND CONFERRING HONORARY TITLES OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW
units.text: <*> The procedure for conferring the honorary title ‘Honorary Citizen of the City of Moscow’ is determined by a law of the City of Moscow.
units.label: INSTRUCTIONS ON THE PROCEDURE FOR GRANTING AWARDS AND CONFERRING HONORARY TITLES OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW · “<*> The procedure for conferring the honorary title ‘Honorary…”

units.locator: INSTRUCTIONS ON THE PROCEDURE FOR GRANTING AWARDS AND CONFERRING HONORARY TITLES OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW
units.text: The procedure for awarding the Certificate of Honour and the Honorary Diploma of the Moscow City Duma is established by the Moscow City Duma; the procedure for awarding the Certificate of Honour of the Government of Moscow is established by the Government of Moscow.
units.label: INSTRUCTIONS ON THE PROCEDURE FOR GRANTING AWARDS AND CONFERRING HONORARY TITLES OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW · “The procedure for awarding the Certificate of Honour and the…”

units.locator: INSTRUCTIONS ON THE PROCEDURE FOR GRANTING AWARDS AND CONFERRING HONORARY TITLES OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW
units.text: 2. Procedure for nomination for awards and honorary titles of the City
units.label: INSTRUCTIONS ON THE PROCEDURE FOR GRANTING AWARDS AND CONFERRING HONORARY TITLES OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW · “2. Procedure for nomination for awards and honorary titles of…”

units.locator: INSTRUCTIONS ON THE PROCEDURE FOR GRANTING AWARDS AND CONFERRING HONORARY TITLES OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW
units.text: 8. Petitions for awards and the conferral of honorary titles (hereinafter, award petitions) are initiated by the workforces (creative teams) of the city’s institutions and organisations, and by state authorities and local self-government bodies.
units.label: INSTRUCTIONS ON THE PROCEDURE FOR GRANTING AWARDS AND CONFERRING HONORARY TITLES OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW · “8. Petitions for awards and the conferral of honorary titles…”

units.locator: INSTRUCTIONS ON THE PROCEDURE FOR GRANTING AWARDS AND CONFERRING HONORARY TITLES OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW
units.text: Residents of Moscow may submit proposals to grant awards and confer honorary titles on individual citizens and workforces. These proposals are sent to local self-government bodies, which consider them together with the institutions and organisations employing the citizens proposed for awards and take the appropriate decision.
units.label: INSTRUCTIONS ON THE PROCEDURE FOR GRANTING AWARDS AND CONFERRING HONORARY TITLES OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW · “Residents of Moscow may submit proposals to grant awards and…”

units.locator: INSTRUCTIONS ON THE PROCEDURE FOR GRANTING AWARDS AND CONFERRING HONORARY TITLES OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW
units.text: Award requests based on citizens’ personal applications are not considered.
units.label: INSTRUCTIONS ON THE PROCEDURE FOR GRANTING AWARDS AND CONFERRING HONORARY TITLES OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW · “Award requests based on citizens’ personal applications are not…”

units.locator: INSTRUCTIONS ON THE PROCEDURE FOR GRANTING AWARDS AND CONFERRING HONORARY TITLES OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW
units.text: Petitions to grant awards to organisations are initiated by sectoral, functional and territorial executive authorities and local self-government bodies.
units.label: INSTRUCTIONS ON THE PROCEDURE FOR GRANTING AWARDS AND CONFERRING HONORARY TITLES OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW · “Petitions to grant awards to organisations are initiated by…”

units.locator: INSTRUCTIONS ON THE PROCEDURE FOR GRANTING AWARDS AND CONFERRING HONORARY TITLES OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW
units.text: Petitions to grant awards to individual citizens may be initiated by sectoral, functional and territorial executive authorities in agreement with the management of the institution or organisation employing the citizens concerned.
units.label: INSTRUCTIONS ON THE PROCEDURE FOR GRANTING AWARDS AND CONFERRING HONORARY TITLES OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW · “Petitions to grant awards to individual citizens may be…”

units.locator: INSTRUCTIONS ON THE PROCEDURE FOR GRANTING AWARDS AND CONFERRING HONORARY TITLES OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW
units.text: 9. Foreign citizens and stateless persons permanently residing in the City of Moscow or in the territory of the Russian Federation are nominated for awards and honorary titles on the general grounds, in agreement with the Department for External Economic and International Relations of the City of Moscow.
units.label: INSTRUCTIONS ON THE PROCEDURE FOR GRANTING AWARDS AND CONFERRING HONORARY TITLES OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW · “9. Foreign citizens and stateless persons permanently residing…”

units.locator: INSTRUCTIONS ON THE PROCEDURE FOR GRANTING AWARDS AND CONFERRING HONORARY TITLES OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW
units.text: Petitions to grant awards to Russian citizens working outside the Russian Federation, and to foreign citizens and stateless persons residing abroad, are initiated by the Department for External Economic and International Relations of the City of Moscow or by other sectoral and functional executive authorities of the city in agreement with that Department.
units.label: INSTRUCTIONS ON THE PROCEDURE FOR GRANTING AWARDS AND CONFERRING HONORARY TITLES OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW · “Petitions to grant awards to Russian citizens working outside…”

units.locator: INSTRUCTIONS ON THE PROCEDURE FOR GRANTING AWARDS AND CONFERRING HONORARY TITLES OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW
units.text: 10. Nominations for awards and honorary titles for staff of the offices of federal state authorities and federal state bodies, military personnel, personnel of the internal affairs bodies of the Russian Federation, the State Fire Service of the Ministry of the Russian Federation for Civil Defence, Emergencies and Elimination of Consequences of Natural Disasters, federal security service bodies, institutions and bodies of the penal enforcement system, prosecution bodies, customs authorities of the Russian Federation, the Investigative Committee of the Russian Federation and the National Guard troops of the Russian Federation, judges and prosecutors, and civilian personnel of the Armed Forces of the Russian Federation are submitted to the Mayor of Moscow by the heads of the relevant federal state authorities or federal state bodies, or by the heads of their territorial structures in the City of Moscow.
units.label: INSTRUCTIONS ON THE PROCEDURE FOR GRANTING AWARDS AND CONFERRING HONORARY TITLES OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW · “10. Nominations for awards and honorary titles for staff of the…”

units.locator: INSTRUCTIONS ON THE PROCEDURE FOR GRANTING AWARDS AND CONFERRING HONORARY TITLES OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW
units.text: Where necessary, those nominations are subject to endorsement by the relevant sectoral and functional executive authorities of the City of Moscow.
units.label: INSTRUCTIONS ON THE PROCEDURE FOR GRANTING AWARDS AND CONFERRING HONORARY TITLES OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW · “Where necessary, those nominations are subject to endorsement…”

units.locator: INSTRUCTIONS ON THE PROCEDURE FOR GRANTING AWARDS AND CONFERRING HONORARY TITLES OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW
units.text: 11. Petitions to grant awards to citizens are drawn up on the award nomination form and must contain biographical information on the candidate and a description of the candidate’s specific achievements and merits (the procedure for completing the award nomination form is set out in Annex 1 to these Instructions).
units.label: INSTRUCTIONS ON THE PROCEDURE FOR GRANTING AWARDS AND CONFERRING HONORARY TITLES OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW · “11. Petitions to grant awards to citizens are drawn up on the…”

units.locator: INSTRUCTIONS ON THE PROCEDURE FOR GRANTING AWARDS AND CONFERRING HONORARY TITLES OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW
units.text: When candidates and works are nominated for prizes, the following are submitted with the award nomination form (or with the petition when a team of authors is nominated): a copy of the decision of the institution’s or organisation’s workforce to nominate the candidate (team of authors) for the prize; certificates and documents confirming the release of the work and the date and place of its publication (performance, exhibition, construction and commissioning) or practical application (implementation); materials demonstrating broad public recognition of the work or candidate nominated for the prize (reviews published in the press and specialists’ assessments and opinions); and materials providing a visual or other illustrative representation of the nominated work (books, photographs, reproductions, audio and video cassettes, posters, programmes and other illustrative materials).
units.label: INSTRUCTIONS ON THE PROCEDURE FOR GRANTING AWARDS AND CONFERRING HONORARY TITLES OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW · “When candidates and works are nominated for prizes, the…”

units.locator: INSTRUCTIONS ON THE PROCEDURE FOR GRANTING AWARDS AND CONFERRING HONORARY TITLES OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW
units.text: When petitions are initiated for awards to workforces and organisations, the head of the organisation, local self-government body or territorial executive authority of the city draws up a free-form petition specifying the production, scientific, creative or other achievements of the workforce, institution or organisation.
units.label: INSTRUCTIONS ON THE PROCEDURE FOR GRANTING AWARDS AND CONFERRING HONORARY TITLES OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW · “When petitions are initiated for awards to workforces and…”

units.locator: INSTRUCTIONS ON THE PROCEDURE FOR GRANTING AWARDS AND CONFERRING HONORARY TITLES OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW
units.text: When a petition is initiated for the honorary title ‘Honorary Inventor of the City of Moscow’, the award nomination form is accompanied by copies of patents (inventor’s certificates) for the invention, utility model or industrial design, information on their practical application, and a written opinion of the Moscow City Organisation of the public organisation, the All-Russian Society of Inventors and Rationalisers.
units.label: INSTRUCTIONS ON THE PROCEDURE FOR GRANTING AWARDS AND CONFERRING HONORARY TITLES OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW · “When a petition is initiated for the honorary title ‘Honorary…”

units.locator: INSTRUCTIONS ON THE PROCEDURE FOR GRANTING AWARDS AND CONFERRING HONORARY TITLES OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW
units.text: 12. Officials who initiate award petitions bear personal responsibility for the correctness and reliability of the information in award nomination forms, petitions for awards to workforces and organisations, and other documents submitted as supporting materials.
units.label: INSTRUCTIONS ON THE PROCEDURE FOR GRANTING AWARDS AND CONFERRING HONORARY TITLES OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW · “12. Officials who initiate award petitions bear personal…”

units.locator: INSTRUCTIONS ON THE PROCEDURE FOR GRANTING AWARDS AND CONFERRING HONORARY TITLES OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW
units.text: 13. Heads of institutions and organisations (except those subordinate to the prefectures of the administrative districts of the City of Moscow) obtain endorsement of award nomination forms from the heads of the relevant sectoral or functional executive authorities of the City of Moscow and from the Deputy Mayor of Moscow in the Government of Moscow who supervises and coordinates the work of the relevant sectoral or functional executive authority.
units.label: INSTRUCTIONS ON THE PROCEDURE FOR GRANTING AWARDS AND CONFERRING HONORARY TITLES OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW · “13. Heads of institutions and organisations (except those…”

units.locator: INSTRUCTIONS ON THE PROCEDURE FOR GRANTING AWARDS AND CONFERRING HONORARY TITLES OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW
units.text: Heads of institutions and organisations subordinate to the prefectures of the administrative districts of the City of Moscow obtain endorsement of award nomination forms from the prefect of the relevant administrative district and from the Deputy Mayor of Moscow in the Government of Moscow who supervises and coordinates the work of the territorial executive authorities of the City of Moscow.
units.label: INSTRUCTIONS ON THE PROCEDURE FOR GRANTING AWARDS AND CONFERRING HONORARY TITLES OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW · “Heads of institutions and organisations subordinate to the…”

units.locator: INSTRUCTIONS ON THE PROCEDURE FOR GRANTING AWARDS AND CONFERRING HONORARY TITLES OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW
units.text: Heads of institutions and organisations send the duly endorsed materials to the Human Resources Policy Directorate of the Government of Moscow.
units.label: INSTRUCTIONS ON THE PROCEDURE FOR GRANTING AWARDS AND CONFERRING HONORARY TITLES OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW · “Heads of institutions and organisations send the duly endorsed…”

units.locator: INSTRUCTIONS ON THE PROCEDURE FOR GRANTING AWARDS AND CONFERRING HONORARY TITLES OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW
units.text: 14. Upon receipt by sectoral or functional executive authorities, prize nomination materials are forwarded for consideration to the relevant expert councils (commissions) for awarding prizes.
units.label: INSTRUCTIONS ON THE PROCEDURE FOR GRANTING AWARDS AND CONFERRING HONORARY TITLES OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW · “14. Upon receipt by sectoral or functional executive…”

units.locator: INSTRUCTIONS ON THE PROCEDURE FOR GRANTING AWARDS AND CONFERRING HONORARY TITLES OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW
units.text: The expert councils (commissions) comprehensively examine the materials, arrange broad public exposure of the work (candidate), analyse the assessments, reviews and specialist opinions received, and other documents describing the work or prize candidate, and at their meetings adopt a decision recommending the award of prizes or rejection of the petition. Award materials signed by the chair of the expert council and endorsed by the head of the sectoral or functional executive authority are forwarded to the Deputy Mayor of Moscow in the Government of Moscow who supervises and coordinates the work of the relevant sectoral or functional executive authority of the City of Moscow. The duly endorsed materials, together with the minutes of the expert council meeting (bearing the original signatures of the members who participated in the vote), are sent to the Human Resources Policy Directorate of the Government of Moscow.
units.label: INSTRUCTIONS ON THE PROCEDURE FOR GRANTING AWARDS AND CONFERRING HONORARY TITLES OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW · “The expert councils (commissions) comprehensively examine the…”

units.locator: INSTRUCTIONS ON THE PROCEDURE FOR GRANTING AWARDS AND CONFERRING HONORARY TITLES OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW
units.text: 15. During the endorsement of award petitions, the head of any endorsing authority may decline to support a petition or propose changing the type of award, explaining the reasons for the decision.
units.label: INSTRUCTIONS ON THE PROCEDURE FOR GRANTING AWARDS AND CONFERRING HONORARY TITLES OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW · “15. During the endorsement of award petitions, the head of any…”

units.locator: INSTRUCTIONS ON THE PROCEDURE FOR GRANTING AWARDS AND CONFERRING HONORARY TITLES OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW
units.text: 16. If the biographical information of a person nominated for an award changes, or circumstances arise that prevent the award, the head of the institution or organisation shall immediately notify the Human Resources Policy Directorate of the Government of Moscow.
units.label: INSTRUCTIONS ON THE PROCEDURE FOR GRANTING AWARDS AND CONFERRING HONORARY TITLES OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW · “16. If the biographical information of a person nominated for…”

units.locator: INSTRUCTIONS ON THE PROCEDURE FOR GRANTING AWARDS AND CONFERRING HONORARY TITLES OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW
units.text: 17. Duly endorsed award petitions are submitted to the Human Resources Policy Directorate of the Government of Moscow, which, after examining and checking the award materials, forwards them to the Commission for Awards and Honorary Titles of the City of Moscow <**> or refuses to accept materials submitted in breach of the prescribed procedure.
units.label: INSTRUCTIONS ON THE PROCEDURE FOR GRANTING AWARDS AND CONFERRING HONORARY TITLES OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW · “17. Duly endorsed award petitions are submitted to the Human…”

units.locator: INSTRUCTIONS ON THE PROCEDURE FOR GRANTING AWARDS AND CONFERRING HONORARY TITLES OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW
units.text: 18. The Commission for Awards and Honorary Titles of the City of Moscow considers the award petitions and expert councils’ recommendations for prizes received and adopts a reasoned decision to support or reject them.
units.label: INSTRUCTIONS ON THE PROCEDURE FOR GRANTING AWARDS AND CONFERRING HONORARY TITLES OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW · “18. The Commission for Awards and Honorary Titles of the City…”

units.locator: INSTRUCTIONS ON THE PROCEDURE FOR GRANTING AWARDS AND CONFERRING HONORARY TITLES OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW
units.text: On the basis of the Commission’s decision, the Human Resources Policy Directorate of the Government of Moscow prepares draft legal acts of the Mayor of Moscow granting awards and conferring honorary titles (hereinafter, award legal acts), or sends reasoned refusals to the institutions, organisations, executive authorities and local self-government bodies that submitted the award petitions.
units.label: INSTRUCTIONS ON THE PROCEDURE FOR GRANTING AWARDS AND CONFERRING HONORARY TITLES OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW · “On the basis of the Commission’s decision, the Human Resources…”

units.locator: INSTRUCTIONS ON THE PROCEDURE FOR GRANTING AWARDS AND CONFERRING HONORARY TITLES OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW
units.text: 19. Copies of award legal acts (extracts) are sent by the Executive Office of the Mayor and Government of Moscow to the heads of federal state authorities, federal state bodies and territorial, sectoral and functional executive authorities of the City of Moscow, who in turn send extracts from the Mayor’s legal acts to subordinate organisations insofar as they concern them.
units.label: INSTRUCTIONS ON THE PROCEDURE FOR GRANTING AWARDS AND CONFERRING HONORARY TITLES OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW · “19. Copies of award legal acts (extracts) are sent by the…”

units.locator: INSTRUCTIONS ON THE PROCEDURE FOR GRANTING AWARDS AND CONFERRING HONORARY TITLES OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW
units.text: 20. On the basis of the copies of the Mayor of Moscow’s award legal acts or extracts received, the personnel departments of institutions and organisations enter the appropriate award records in recipients’ personnel files, employment record books (where available) and other records.
units.label: INSTRUCTIONS ON THE PROCEDURE FOR GRANTING AWARDS AND CONFERRING HONORARY TITLES OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW · “20. On the basis of the copies of the Mayor of Moscow’s award…”

units.locator: INSTRUCTIONS ON THE PROCEDURE FOR GRANTING AWARDS AND CONFERRING HONORARY TITLES OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW
units.text: 21. The Mayor of Moscow revokes an award legal act if the nomination for the award (honorary title) is found to be inaccurate or unfounded.
units.label: INSTRUCTIONS ON THE PROCEDURE FOR GRANTING AWARDS AND CONFERRING HONORARY TITLES OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW · “21. The Mayor of Moscow revokes an award legal act if the…”

units.locator: INSTRUCTIONS ON THE PROCEDURE FOR GRANTING AWARDS AND CONFERRING HONORARY TITLES OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW
units.text: The award (breast badge for an honorary title) and its document presented to a person in respect of whom a decree revoking the award has been issued must be returned to the Human Resources Policy Directorate of the Government of Moscow. Officials responsible for an unfounded nomination for an award (honorary title) bear personal responsibility.
units.label: INSTRUCTIONS ON THE PROCEDURE FOR GRANTING AWARDS AND CONFERRING HONORARY TITLES OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW · “The award (breast badge for an honorary title) and its document…”

units.locator: INSTRUCTIONS ON THE PROCEDURE FOR GRANTING AWARDS AND CONFERRING HONORARY TITLES OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW
units.text: 22. The Mayor of Moscow may restore a citizen’s rights to awards (an honorary title) if the citizen is rehabilitated or if the act for which the recipient was deprived of the awards has ceased to be socially dangerous.
units.label: INSTRUCTIONS ON THE PROCEDURE FOR GRANTING AWARDS AND CONFERRING HONORARY TITLES OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW · “22. The Mayor of Moscow may restore a citizen’s rights to…”

units.locator: INSTRUCTIONS ON THE PROCEDURE FOR GRANTING AWARDS AND CONFERRING HONORARY TITLES OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW
units.text: Restoration of rights to an award is considered on the basis of a petition initiated by a local self-government body or the head of an organisation following the citizen’s personal application, under the procedure established for nomination for awards and honorary titles. The petition must be accompanied by a certificate from the relevant archive confirming the award, a rehabilitation certificate, a certificate from the penal enforcement authorities confirming completion of the sentence or release on parole from imprisonment, and other documents supporting an objective decision on the possibility of restoring rights to the award. After the Mayor’s decree restoring rights to awards enters into force, the awards and their documents are returned to the recipient.

units.text: On the instructions of the Mayor of Moscow, they may be presented by Deputy Mayors of Moscow in the Government of Moscow, heads of territorial, sectoral and functional executive authorities of the City of Moscow, and other officials authorised by the Mayor of Moscow.

units.text: Awards and breast badges for honorary titles (hereinafter, presentation of awards) are presented no later than two months after the relevant award legal act is issued.
